claims.claim: Human genetic support sits on JAK2 (genetic_association=0.8458)

claims.reason: TYK2 0.2863 is higher than JAK1 at 0.0.

claims.claim: JAK2 and TYK2 carry the interleukin-23 receptor signal
claims.quote: binds to a heterodimeric receptor complex composed of IL12RB1 and IL23R to activate JAK2 and TYK2
claims.reason: IL-23 receptor activates JAK2 and TYK2.

claims.quote: tofacitinib was more effective as induction and maintenance therapy than placebo
claims.reason: Phase 3 UC trials show efficacy over placebo.

claims.claim: Tofacitinib, like the others, inhibits JAK1-dependent pathways most potently but acts more than filgotinib on JAK2- and JAK3-dependent ones
claims.quote: Filgotinib inhibited JAK1-mediated signalling similarly to other JAKinibs, but with less inhibition of JAK2-dependent and JAK3-dependent pathways
claims.reason: JAK1 pathways most potently inhibited by all; filgotinib less on JAK2/JAK3.

claims.claim: Upadacitinib is a selective JAK1 inhibitor that worked in UC
claims.quote: upadacitinib, an oral selective Janus kinase 1 inhibitor
claims.reason: Described as selective JAK1 inhibitor with positive efficacy in UC.

claims.claim: Filgotinib is a JAK1-preferential inhibitor that worked in UC
claims.quote: filgotinib, a once-daily, oral Janus kinase 1 preferential inhibitor

claims.claim: JAK2 also carries erythropoietin and thrombopoietin receptor signals
The selective deucravacitinib did not show significant benefit over placebo in UC phase 2
claims.quote: Deucravacitinib at multiple doses did not demonstrate significant clinical benefit vs placebo in moderately to severely active Crohn's disease or ulcerative colitis.

claims.claim: Brepocitinib, a TYK2/JAK1 inhibitor, was more effective than placebo in UC phase 2b
claims.quote: Ritlecitinib and brepocitinib induction therapies were more effective than placebo
claims.reason: Phase 2b study, brepocitinib TYK2/JAK1, more effective than placebo.
